description: Enemy prefixes rolled when a room's enemy is created (and the final boss's Demon mark). Tags only for now: they are stored on Enemy.PrefixTags and the name, and drive no mechanics yet. 'idea' is the intended mechanic.

prefixes.name: Demon
prefixes.idea: Final-boss mark. A second phase at 50% HP that adds one action to its sequence; drains a little of the hero's material currency per hit; guaranteed rare drop.

prefixes.name: Undead
prefixes.idea: Rises once at 30% HP after its first death. Immune to bleed and poison, takes extra damage from fire and holy.

prefixes.name: Skeleton
prefixes.idea: Bones shrug off blades and piercing (dagger and sword hits reduced) but shatter under blunt hits (maces deal extra). A Barbarian-favoured matchup.

prefixes.name: Ghost
prefixes.idea: Physical hits have a chance to pass through; magic hits land normally. A Wizard-favoured matchup.

prefixes.name: Giant
prefixes.idea: More HP and harder hits, slower swings. Staggers (loses its next action) on a critical hit.

prefixes.name: Tiny
prefixes.idea: Less HP, faster swings, raises the hero's hit threshold by 1 (harder to hit).

prefixes.name: Feral
prefixes.idea: Swings faster as it loses HP (enrage below 50%).

prefixes.name: Armored
prefixes.idea: High Defense until sundered or exposed; rewards SUNDER, EXPOSE and pierce.

prefixes.name: Ancient
prefixes.idea: One extra action in its sequence; more XP and a better loot roll.

prefixes.name: Corrupted
prefixes.idea: Applies a stacking curse that lowers the hero's healing; drops Shadow and Obsidian materials more often.

prefixes.name: Blazing
prefixes.idea: Burns on hit and is immune to burn. More common in the Fire region.

prefixes.name: Frozen
prefixes.idea: Slows the hero on hit; a critical hit shatters it for bonus damage.

prefixes.name: Venomous
prefixes.idea: Poisons on hit; immune to poison.

prefixes.name: Hallowed
prefixes.idea: Regenerates a little HP each turn; takes extra damage from shadow.

prefixes.name: Cursed
prefixes.idea: Killing it applies a short debuff to the hero; drops items with a cursed affix more often.
